t.text: Screen remote: controlling the Mac's screen from the phone

h1.text: Phone screens. One mechanic underneath (cursor-centered viewport, gestures from CRD); they differ in where the finger goes

annotations.text: A + A′ copy CRD: the most familiar, works in both orientations. Downside: in portrait the Mac is a narrow slice and the toolbar covers part of it.

My pick for portrait: B. The finger never sits on the picture, the trackpad and big mic match the existing Mac remote sheet, and holding the mic dictates into whatever field is under the cursor. Rotate to landscape and it becomes A′.
C is a second mode behind the toolbar switch, like CRD. E is the Helm-only idea: stream one window and have the Mac resize it to phone shape, so nothing needs zooming. Good v2.
